reason: B proposes a mechanism directly relevant to low-temperature plasticity in BCC refractory alloys—modification of screw-dislocation cores and the Peierls barrier—whereas A imports carbon-induced TWIP/TRIP from a metastable FCC/HCP alloy and is unlikely to produce that mechanism in stable BCC NbMoTaW, where carbon may instead form carbides or embrittle grain boundaries. B remains weakly supported and must specify which elements V replaces, but its composition-controlled comparison and multiregime tests make it the more physically plausible and falsifiable proposal.
